examples.arabic: أمي، الله يطول بعمرها، صارت عم تحضّر القهوة السخنة، وإخوتي الصغار مبسوطين عم بيلعبوا جوّا البيت.
examples.english: My mother, may God prolong her life, started preparing the hot coffee, and my younger siblings are happy playing inside the house.
examples.transliteration: ommi, Allah ytawwil bi-'omraha, sarat amm t'haddir al-qahwe as-sukhneh, w ikhweti az-zghar mabsoteen amm bayla'bu jawwa al-bet.
examples.storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

examples.arabic: "شو رأيكم نجلس هلق جوا وناكل كعك أمي اللي خبزتّو مبارح؟ رح نضل عم نتذكر هالليلية كتير!" قالت صديقتنا مها.
examples.english: "What do you think if we sit inside now and eat my mother's cookies that she baked yesterday? We will keep remembering this night a lot!" said our friend Maha.
examples.transliteration: "shoo ra'ykum nijles hala' jooa w naakol ka'ek immi illi khabazetto mbaareh? rah ndall 'am natzakkar hal-layliye kteer!" qaalat sadeeqatna Maha.

examples.arabic: برا كان في رعد وبرق بس البيت كان دافي من جوا
examples.english: Outside there was thunder and lightning but the house was warm from the inside
examples.transliteration: Barra kan fi raed w barq bas el bayt kan dafi mn juwa

examples.arabic: جوا المحل كان فيه ريحة قماش جديد حلوة وموسيقى ناعمة عم تعزف
examples.english: Inside the shop, there was a nice smell of new fabric and soft music playing.
examples.transliteration: Juwwa el mahal kan fee reehet qamash jdeed helwe w museeqa naame am taazef

examples.english: I am sitting inside the house.
Inside the house it's warm and comfortable.
